chunks.text: Its pitch wanders with the load, the same way across India's one grid.
This example is a calibration stream, not a blind result.
A YouTube bot check stopped downloads after a hundred and twenty-six of a hundred and fifty streams.
For twenty-five, Gunj's best guess was within thirty seconds.
Fourteen were within thirty seconds and nine were wrong.
Correcting it matters: thirty-eight test streams lock with it, nine without.
